## Purpose

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests updated
- [ ] No secrets, environment files, installed dependencies, or build output included

For UI or routing changes, describe browser checks of the counter, direct deep
links, refreshes, back/forward, and unknown routes. Distinguish local preview
checks from live Builder deployment results.

## Breaking changes

Describe any changed routes, environment variables, or deployment behavior.
